subject: Can’t complete supplier setup — Safari deep-link truncates relaystate (Hearthstone Tools)
messages:
From: Kyle Owen <kyle.owen@hearthstone-tools.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:17:12 -0700
Subject: Unable to finish vendor setup - "Accept" deep link fails on iPhone Safari

Hi Karthik,

We received the supplier portal invite and when our procurement lead taps the "Accept invite" deep link on an iPhone (iOS 16.4, Safari) the page loads but immediately shows "Invalid tenant parameter" and redirects back to our company site. Desktop Chrome works fine. We tried clearing cookies, and using private mode but the same result.

Can you advise? We're blocked from finishing banking details and the first PO is scheduled tomorrow.

Attaching a quick screenshot and the browser network trace (small text file).

Thanks,
Kyle Owen
Head of Procurement

Hi Kyle — thanks for the report and the attachments.

Quick checklist while we dig in:
- Can you confirm if the vendor user is on your corporate VPN or a company-managed mobile browser (some enterprise proxies rewrite Host/RelayState)?
- If you have a mac/desktop handy, can you confirm Chrome accepts the invite (you mentioned it does — that helps)
- If possible, try opening the invite link using Safari but with the URL manually copied into a private window (sometimes iOS link handlers introduce an extra redirect)

We're escalating to product/engineering to inspect relaystate handling for Safari mobile. Ben — can you pull the edge logs for that invite token (I saw a token in the trace: token=eyJr...71a) and check whether X-Forwarded-Host was rewritten by any CDN rule today?

I'll follow up with a narrower workaround for Hearthstone ASAP.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kyle Owen <kyle.owen@hearthstone-tools.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:02:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Unable to finish vendor setup - "Accept" deep link fails on iPhone Safari

FW: Kyle's trace attached. Quick findings from edge logs:
- The relayState parameter is present on initial request, but a proxy in front of the vendor (we see X-Forwarded-Host: intranet.hearthstone.local) is stripping the tenant suffix when it rewrites the Host header during the mobile redirect.
- Safari's link handling causes the invite to be opened via an in-app browser on some corporate setups which bubbles through the intranet proxy.

Suggested short-term workaround for Kyle: open the invite link in Safari, then manually append the tenant query param as: "&tenant=hearthstone-tools" (we'll offer a safer link in a sec). Long-term we should add a Host header fallback for relayState parsing and detect suspicious X-Forwarded-Host values.

Marissa — can you create a quick patch request for INF-4721 and include the edge sample? I'll attach the trace to the ticket.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Systems Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: edge-sample-logs-4721.txt (text/plain)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Owen <kyle.owen@hearthstone-tools.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:04:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Unable to finish vendor setup - "Accept" deep link fails on iPhone Safari

Kyle — thanks for the quick turnaround and the trace.

Ben confirmed the mobile corporate proxy is rewriting Host and stripping the tenant fragment during the redirect. Two options to get you unblocked for today's PO:

1) Open the invite link on a desktop (Chrome or Safari) — that should let you finish onboarding immediately.
2) On the iPhone Safari URL bar, after tapping the invite link but before it redirects, tap the URL and append: &tenant=hearthstone-tools then press return. That should force the tenant param.

We've also created INF-4721 and attached the logs; engineering will push a fallback in the next sprint to tolerate X-Forwarded-Host rewrites. I'll mark this high priority and follow up when the patch is live.

Ben / Marissa will reach out if they need additional logs. If you prefer we can also generate a single-use deep link that forces the tenant param — let me know and I'll send it.

Best,
Karthik
